_comment: External references the rebuilt NativeAOT runtime and minipal archives may keep without crossing the boundary. Every entry is a link-time contract that is not an OS service: names the compiler output defines, the C++ ABI, compiler runtime builtins, the freestanding C runtime contract, libm, the event tracing archives, and two assembler artifacts. Anything else outside the boundary is unreviewed and fails the isolation gate.

managed-contract.reason: Defined by the ILCompiler output, System.Private.CoreLib or the bootstrapper of every NativeAOT executable.

runtime-internal.reason: Defined by another member of the runtime's own archive set (GC selector, event lock, vxsort kernels).

event-tracing-contract.reason: Provided by the eventpipe archive the SDK links (enabled or disabled); it is audited with the runtime, not an OS service.

cxx-abi.reason: Itanium C++ ABI entry points every C++ runtime supplies: allocation operators, static destructor registration, guards.

compiler-builtin.reason: Compiler runtime builtins by exact family: outline atomics, cache maintenance, stack protector, libgcc integer and floating helpers.

crt-freestanding.reason: The freestanding C runtime contract (string, memory, formatting, number parsing, errno, termination and exit hooks). native/freestanding provides it without OS calls; a hosted target takes it from its libc.

libm.reason: C math library functions the GC and generated code call; pure computation with no OS state.

assembler-artifact.reason: GNU as treats ';' as a statement separator on AArch64, so the comment 'x14 = dst' in the write barrier assembly becomes a symbol assignment that references dst and val; no relocation uses them and the linker drops them.

vxsort-isa-contract.reason: Defined by src/coreclr/gc/vxsort/isa_detection.cpp or dummy.cpp at the audited runtime pin. The enabled implementation uses minipal_getcpufeatures (the rebuilt, audited minipal) and local state only. The disabled implementation returns false and performs no OS operation.
